newsitem.title: GREECE: Riopesca says H1 strong, earnings up 53pct.
newsitem.headline: Riopesca says H1 strong, earnings up 53pct.

text.p: Riopesca Fisheries, a subsidiary of Selonda Aquaculture, expects to post strong first-half results with pretax earnings up 53 percent to 700 million drachmas versus 457 million in the same period a year earlier.
First half sales grew 68 percent to 1.7 billion drachmas, confirming earlier projections.
Riopesca officials told Reuters 1997 sales were expected to advance to 3.2 billion drachmas from 2.09 billion in 1996, bringing in pretax earnings of 1.2 billion.
Riopesca has acquired the remaining 20 percent in Triton Fisheries and now owns 100 percent of the hatchery.
Triton will complete a new hatchery facility in Thesprotia in the first half and commence fry production in the second half of 1997.

This year Riopesca expects to double its output to 35 million fry while it will be fish farming sargus after last year's successful pilot project which put out 13 tonnes of the farmed species. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
